failure: an interview run edited Working Style directly once the answers were in, skipping the proposal batch
root_cause: treated the interview loop as a write loop; the ledger answers were composed straight into the file instead of into a batch presented for sign-off
guard: nothing enters Profile unapproved or unmarked; the loop only fills the ledger, Calvin composes the batch, the user approves line by line, and only then does the lead write (SKILL.md pipeline steps 7 to 10)

case: confirm mode dropped a marker without a yes
failure: a confirm sweep shortened an `unconfirmed` marker to `confirmed` when the user shrugged rather than confirming
root_cause: a non-answer was read as approval; the confirm-pass item lacked a real skip disposition
guard: a shrug or skip leaves the marker untouched; only an explicit yes shortens observed+unconfirmed to confirmed, and search unconfirmed must still find the untouched line afterward (references/provenance.md, references/question-maps.md)

case: facet-named run ignored the caller's facet
failure: the user said 'let's fill in my Working Style' but the run targeted the coverage report's Biography instead
root_cause: the coverage target was taken unconditionally; caller-named precedence was not applied
guard: caller-named wins over coverage; when the caller names a facet the pipeline scopes to it, consent gate included if it is sensitive (SKILL.md modes, pipeline step 2)

case: sensitive facet opened without the consent gate
failure: a run jumped straight into Health questions because coverage named it the thinnest facet
root_cause: the sensitive-facet list was not checked before starting; thinnest-wins overrode opt-in
guard: Health, Finances, Values, and Relationships open only on opt-in: one question-tool ask offering that facet, the two next-thinnest non-sensitive alternatives, and 'not today'; declining is a routing answer, never a recorded skip (references/interviewing.md, SKILL.md pipeline step 3)

failure: the proposal batch noted 'user declined the income question' as a line, and the session summary logged the refusal
root_cause: the skip was treated as data; the refusal leaked from the session-only ledger into a persisted artifact
guard: skips are silent and stateless: never probed again, never written in the batch, a marker, Memory, or the summary; the session-only ledger notes the id purely so the run does not re-ask, and that note dies with the session (references/interviewing.md)

case: a memory-shaped fact landed in Profile
failure: a named person the user leans on was written into Relationships as a line diff
root_cause: modeled the person as a Profile fact instead of routing it to a Memory promotion
guard: people, events, dates, and decisions are Memory promotions, written into Memory in the format Memory/Memory.md shows, never a Profile diff; Profile keeps only the user-fact phrasing such as the relational style (Memory/Memory.md and Profile/Profile.md, Rules; references/provenance.md)
